\section*{\frakfamily Perfect Pangrams \normalfont: Perfect Pangrams}

\noindent {\frakfamily 1. Pack my box with five dozen liquor jugs.} \\
\hspace{2em} Pack my box with five dozen liquor jugs. \medskip \\

\noindent {\frakfamily 2. The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.} \\
\hspace{2em} The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. \medskip \\

\noindent {\frakfamily 3. Sphinx of black quartz, judge my vow.} \\
\hspace{2em} Sphinx of black quartz, judge my vow. \medskip \\

\noindent {\frakfamily 4. Waltz, bad nymph, for quick jigs vex.} \\
\hspace{2em} Waltz, bad nymph, for quick jigs vex. \medskip \\

\noindent {\frakfamily 5. Glib jocks quiz nymph to vex dwarf.} \\
\hspace{2em} Glib jocks quiz nymph to vex dwarf. \medskip \\

\noindent {\frakfamily 6. How quickly daft jumping zebras vex!} \\
\hspace{2em} How quickly daft jumping zebras vex! \medskip \\

\noindent {\frakfamily 7. The five boxing wizards jump quickly.} \\
\hspace{2em} The five boxing wizards jump quickly. \medskip \\

\noindent {\frakfamily 8. Jackdaws love my big sphinx of quartz.} \\
\hspace{2em} Jackdaws love my big sphinx of quartz. \medskip \\
